responsibility: Defines the RL78 backend’s machine-description operand constraints used by reload, recognition, and instruction selection. It assigns target-specific immediate ranges, register classes and names, and a detailed set of near/far memory-addressing constraints for RL78 forms such as AX/BC/DE/HL/SP-relative accesses, SADDR/SFR references, ES-prefixed far accesses, virtual-register operands, compare-code classes, and mov-capable memory forms, giving the md patterns in rl78-*.md the vocabulary needed to distinguish legal addressing and operand encodings.
